artifact_purpose: Tier 1 participation and eligibility rules for a Horizon Europe Research and Innovation Action, extracted from the 2026-2027 General Annexes. Populated by the 'Tier 1 and Tier 2A coverage check for an RIA' ticket in plans/dev_graph_demo_tickets.md, which found this file empty. The consortium-composition condition is the rule the consortium ticket evaluates its country slots against. Every rule carries the verbatim span it is read from, so no rule here rests on programme knowledge (CLAUDE.md §10.6).
instrument_scope: RIA. The consortium-composition condition and the funding-eligibility country limbs are type-of-action-neutral and are recorded as such. The China restriction is type-of-action-specific and is recorded per type of action.

usage_rules: The consortium-composition condition is the Tier 1 rule the consortium ticket evaluates its country slots against. It counts beneficiaries, not partners: an affiliated entity adds no country.

Eligibility to participate and eligibility for funding are separate tests. A partner may be eligible to participate and ineligible for funding, and a consortium that meets composition on participation alone does not meet it on beneficiary status.

The China restriction must be resolved against the destination of the specific topic, not against the type of action alone. This project's destination is on the exempt list, so the restriction does not bind it.
Where a call or topic condition is stricter than a rule here, the call condition governs for that call. Tier 2B carries the topic's own eligibility conditions.
A country list here is correct at the time the work programme was adopted. It is not a live register, and the General Annexes say so.
field_status_note: Every block is Confirmed because every rule in it is a verbatim span of a named page of a stored Tier 1 source (CLAUDE.md §12.2). The one non-enumerated limb, low_and_middle_income_countries, is Confirmed as a limb and declares that it is not enumerated. It is not Confirmed as a country list.
